note: Provisional statements transcribed from the gate expansion package written for issue #317; the maintainer replaces them. Each statement also carries the source set's measured note and its original verification expression (verify, a Python-level expression over the loaded frame); check states the same fact as a single Polars expression, which is the form the gate evaluates. The corpus entry parses the date column at load, so the check expressions use it directly; the source verify expressions parse the raw date strings and state the same facts.
